name: paper-lightbox
title: Paper lightbox
summary: Layered cut paper lit from behind at night: an indigo sky, warm arches on one side, neon on the other, a gold inlay medallion, and a wet floor mirroring both.

look.ground: an indigo night sky backdrop with faint stars; a dark wet floor below the feet line

palette.where: sky, building sheets toned toward night
the favoured side (right): windows, medallion gold

look.type: Playfair Display italic, cream, one line at a time; 16:9 at the bottom over the floor, 9:16 at the top
look.texture: paper fibre on every sheet, a thin rim of light on the edge facing the light, soft vignette; no grain
look.light: lit from behind: lights are separate additive sheets (windows, signs, sun); each side has its own colour of light
look.materials: flat coloured paper sheets with hand-cut edges; inlay pieces with dark leading

consistency: faceless figures on a capsule skeleton, drawn live; one hero object (a medallion) carried across the film

motion.feel: one continuous take; pieces burst, gather and lock
moves: camera: one slow push or pull, sheets in parallax by depth
medallion: burst to five spiral arms in 0.5 s, lock with ease-out-back staggered by radius then angle
scatter that stays in view: ease 1 - e^(-4u), end in piles on one side
wet floor: 6 px strips swaying sin(y*0.05 + 2.2t), alpha 0.62(1-d)^1.5
words rise 14 px and unblur, 0.14 s apart

pace.text: a 20 s saying in one scene; one line of text per phrase

banned: cutting between two places (split one scene down an axis instead)
source: the paper lightbox recipes in an open MIT skill (klsoen/opus-js-animations, references/styles.md); no reference clip, so pace is the recipe's, not measured
